### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

### Problem / Motivation
Is this related to a specific limitation or verification problem? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or design you'd like to see, including any CLI changes or manifest schema impacts.

### Determinism & Falsifiability Impact
Does this change impact model serialization, hash computation, or determinism guarantees? How can it be shown to *fail when it should* (falsifiability)?

### Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or links here.
